headlines.title_zh: 支付科技公司Imprint获1.3亿美元融资
headlines.title_en: Imprint, which helps companies offer co-branded credit cards and manage loyalty programs, raised $130M led by Khosla Ventures at a ~$1.9B valuation (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 联名信用卡平台Imprint完成1.3亿美元融资，估值近19亿美元，以此扩张其零售商忠诚度管理业务
headlines.event_summary_en: Fintech startup Imprint has raised $130 million led by Khosla Ventures, reaching a valuation of approximately $1.9 billion. The company specializes in managing co-branded credit cards and loyalty programs for retailers and airlines, aiming to scale further after hitting 2 million cardholders and $400 million in annual revenue.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Imprint（金融科技公司）在融资轮次（Khosla Ventures领投）：完成1.3亿美元融资，估值近19亿美元，实现用户与营收的快速增长。
【起因与机理】借力零售业数字化转型需求，以联名卡业务实现规模化盈利。
【关键数据与实测】Imprint完成1.3亿美元融资，估值近19亿美元。
【观点态度】凭借高效增长模型，持卡用户突破200万，年营收达4亿美元。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Imprint: Secured $130 million at a $1.9B valuation, scaling user base and revenue.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Capitalizing on the digitalization of retail loyalty programs.
[Key Metrics] Imprint raised $130M at a ~$1.9B valuation.
[Perspective & Impact] Scaled to 2M+ users and $400M revenue via efficient growth.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 在全硅谷都忙着往PPT里塞‘AI’的时候，Imprint靠发联名信用卡活生生把估值冲到了19亿，这不仅证明了卖水的人最赚钱，还证明了只要手续费收得够狠，没人会在意你是不是AI公司。当大家都在烧钱讲大模型故事时，人家已经在超市排队口薅走两百万用户的羊毛了。
headlines.industry_impact_en: While everyone else in Silicon Valley is busy jamming 'AI' into their pitch decks, Imprint is printing money with old-school credit cards and hitting a $1.9B valuation. It turns out that if you can actually pull millions of users out of grocery store lines, investors don't care if your 'AI' strategy is just basic math.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
